title: Review of the reactive-Marangoni negative on fresh seeds 32 and 33: with the inverse heat-Marangoni flow (m -0.15) burning spots move at most 1.4-2.1 body lengths, as in the m 0 twin (1.5-1.8), and m -1 collapses heat into 60 still spots (max 0.6 lengths)
summary: labkit at the finding's settings (128^2, T=600, 1 t frames), the finding's world.py. m -0.15, seeds 32 and 33: 17 and 23 bodies at the end, 11 and 19 persistent tracks, 6 and 4 persistent splits (generation 1 and 2), max 1.4 and 2.1 body lengths, max speed 0.027/0.025. m 0 twin, same seeds: 16 and 24 bodies, 12 and 15 persistent splits (generation 2), max 1.5 and 1.8 body lengths, max speed 0.038/0.033. m -1, seed 32: 60 point-like spots, 0 long-lived movers, max 0.6 body lengths. The m -0.15 sheet (seed 33) shows round spots that stay in place and occasionally split; none translates.

observations.M: pack_m15/seed33/sheet.png: still round spots; max 1.4 and 2.1 body lengths with m -0.15 vs 1.5 and 1.8 in the m 0 twin (m15.log, m0.log); m -1: 60 still points, max 0.6 lengths (pack_m100/FACTS.md): the Marangoni flow does not propel the burning spots

controls_run.M: pack_m0/ (m 0 twin, seeds 32 and 33) and pack_m100/ (m -1, seed 32)

verdicts.limitation: I did not re-run the normal-sign dispersal or the fuel-driven tension arms. 'Supported' means the negative result replicates.
